intro.label: Project timeline
intro.title: Everything I've worked on since 2019.
intro.lede: Newest first. Real jobs, with what I was brought in to do and what actually came out of it.

entries.summary: Rebuilding a four server network off one badly overloaded Paper box, and training the staff so they can run it without me. Average tick time is down from 41ms to 12ms, and the operations handbook runs to 32 pages.

Took a 400 member Discord with no real structure and turned it into a 12,000 member community with a mod team that runs itself. Manual moderator actions dropped by roughly 70% once ticket routing was in.
Everything for a seasonal SMP. Economy, land claims, 60 custom items and the quest chain that carried the first season. Launched on time and still had 38% of its players at day 30.
Called in after a permissions rewrite locked half the staff team out mid season. Rebuilt 90 tangled groups into 14 inherited tracks over a weekend, then stayed on to run the team.

A run of automation contracts across eleven Discord communities. One verification and ticket stack, built once and rolled out to all of them, with documentation so each owner could edit it themselves.
Learned this the usual way. Running a friend's survival server, breaking it, and working out exactly why it broke. Started taking paid work in late 2021.
